mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log(operator_id, operator_name, role, action, detail, created_time) VALUES(#{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{role}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{createdTime})
mapper.select: SELECT log_id AS logId, operator_id AS operatorId, operator_name AS operatorName, role, action, detail, created_time AS createdTime FROM audit_log ORDER BY log_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
